# ScreenshotMAX API

> ScreenshotMAX API documentation

## Docs

- [Delete Task](https://docs.screenshotmax.com/endpoints/delete-tasks.md): Delete a scheduled task
- [Devices](https://docs.screenshotmax.com/endpoints/devices.md): Get a list of available devices for emulation.
- [Pdf](https://docs.screenshotmax.com/endpoints/get-pdf.md): Generate a PDF from a webpage.
- [Scrape](https://docs.screenshotmax.com/endpoints/get-scrape.md): Scrape data from webpages.
- [Screencast](https://docs.screenshotmax.com/endpoints/get-screencast.md): Capture high-quality animated screenshots of webpages.
- [Screenshot](https://docs.screenshotmax.com/endpoints/get-screenshot.md): Capture high-quality screenshots of webpages.
- [List Tasks](https://docs.screenshotmax.com/endpoints/get-tasks.md): Get all your scheduled tasks
- [Get Task](https://docs.screenshotmax.com/endpoints/get-tasks-id.md): Get a scheduled task
- [Update Task](https://docs.screenshotmax.com/endpoints/patch-tasks.md): Update a scheduled task
- [Pdf](https://docs.screenshotmax.com/endpoints/post-pdf.md): Generate a PDF from a webpage.
- [Scrape](https://docs.screenshotmax.com/endpoints/post-scrape.md): Scrape data from webpages.
- [Screencast](https://docs.screenshotmax.com/endpoints/post-screencast.md): Capture high-quality animated screenshots of webpages.
- [Screenshot](https://docs.screenshotmax.com/endpoints/post-screenshot.md): Capture high-quality screenshots of webpages.
- [Create Task](https://docs.screenshotmax.com/endpoints/post-tasks.md): Create a new scheduled task
- [Usage](https://docs.screenshotmax.com/endpoints/usage.md): Get usage statistics for your account.

- [Make](https://docs.screenshotmax.com/guides/no-code/make.md)

- [Devices](https://docs.screenshotmax.com/guides/references/devices.md): Get a list of available devices for emulation
- [HTML to PDF Options](https://docs.screenshotmax.com/guides/references/pdf-options.md): Customize HTML to PDF generation with ScreenshotMAX API
- [Web Scraping Options](https://docs.screenshotmax.com/guides/references/scrape-options.md): Customize web scraping with ScreenshotMAX API
- [Animated Screenshot Options](https://docs.screenshotmax.com/guides/references/screencast-options.md): Customize animated screenshot generation with ScreenshotMAX API
- [Screenshot Options](https://docs.screenshotmax.com/guides/references/screenshot-options.md): Customize screenshot generation with ScreenshotMAX API
- [Get Usage](https://docs.screenshotmax.com/guides/references/usage.md): Get usage statistics for your account
- [C#](https://docs.screenshotmax.com/guides/sdks/csharp.md): The ScreenshotMAX C# SDK provides a streamlined interface for integrating ScreenshotMAX’s screenshot capabilities into your Go applications. It simplifies tasks such as authentication, request signing, and interacting with the ScreenshotMAX API.
- [Go Code Samples](https://docs.screenshotmax.com/guides/sdks/go.md): Use ScreenshotMAX API in Go to capture website screenshots, automate rendering tasks, and securely generate images with signed API requests. Fast, reliable, and developer-friendly.
- [Java Code Samples](https://docs.screenshotmax.com/guides/sdks/java.md): Use ScreenshotMAX API in Java to capture website screenshots, automate rendering tasks, and securely generate images with signed API requests. Fast, reliable, and developer-friendly.
- [JavaScript TypeScript SDK](https://docs.screenshotmax.com/guides/sdks/nodejs-javascript-typescript.md): The ScreenshotMAX SDK for JavaScript and TypeScript offers a clean, developer-friendly interface for accessing the ScreenshotMAX API. It handles authentication, request signing, and URL generation, making it easy to capture screenshots and integrate advanced rendering features into your applications…
- [PHP SDK](https://docs.screenshotmax.com/guides/sdks/php.md): The ScreenshotMAX PHP SDK provides a streamlined interface for integrating ScreenshotMAX’s screenshot capabilities into your PHP applications. It simplifies tasks such as authentication, request signing, and interacting with the ScreenshotMAX API.
- [Python SDK](https://docs.screenshotmax.com/guides/sdks/python.md): The ScreenshotMAX Python SDK provides a streamlined interface for integrating ScreenshotMAX’s screenshot capabilities into your Python applications. It simplifies tasks such as authentication, request signing, and interacting with the ScreenshotMAX API.
- [Animated Screenshots](https://docs.screenshotmax.com/guides/start/animated-screenshots.md): The screencast endpoint lets you generate short video captures of your webpage — either as a static animation (video) or a dynamic scroll-through (scroll). It’s great for showcasing your app, previewing a website, or generating media content programmatically.
- [API Domains](https://docs.screenshotmax.com/guides/start/api-domains.md): Understand the regional API domains available for ScreenshotMAX.
- [Async and Webhooks](https://docs.screenshotmax.com/guides/start/async-webhooks.md): For long-running or high-volume tasks, you can choose to receive the result asynchronously via a webhook.
- [Authentication](https://docs.screenshotmax.com/guides/start/authentication.md): Learn how to authenticate your requests to the ScreenshotMAX API using your unique API access key. This guide covers the authentication process for both GET and POST requests, ensuring secure and efficient access to our services.
- [GPU Rendering](https://docs.screenshotmax.com/guides/start/gpu-rendering.md): Enable lightning-fast and high-fidelity rendering using GPU acceleration.
- [Introduction](https://docs.screenshotmax.com/guides/start/introduction.md): Welcome to the ScreenshotMAX API. This guide will help you quickly integrate our API into your project. Whether you need to capture screenshots, record animated screenshots, generate PDFs, or scrape webpage content, our API offers a simple and flexible solution using both GET and POST requests.
- [IP Ranges](https://docs.screenshotmax.com/guides/start/ip-ranges.md): List of IP ranges used by ScreenshotMAX API infrastructure.
- [Quickstart](https://docs.screenshotmax.com/guides/start/quickstart.md): Making your first request
- [Scheduled Tasks](https://docs.screenshotmax.com/guides/start/scheduled-tasks.md): Scheduled Tasks allow you to automatically trigger API calls at regular intervals, without any manual action. Perfect for automation, monitoring, and recurring data capture.
- [Signed Requests](https://docs.screenshotmax.com/guides/start/signed-requests.md): Generate signed requests for secure communication with ScreenshotMAX API
- [Captchas](https://docs.screenshotmax.com/guides/tutorials/captchas.md)
- [Performance](https://docs.screenshotmax.com/guides/tutorials/performance.md)
- [Proxies](https://docs.screenshotmax.com/guides/tutorials/proxies.md)
